clockPolicy.state: Preserve original SOUND_PLAY time. Candidate state time divides by ANIM_SPEED, matching existing player-sound presentation convention. NPC native sound clock ownership is not independently established; unscaled alternative is retained.
clockPolicy.effect: Mage ball SOUND0 is .01 into the independent effect lifetime used by the existing candidate runner. Under its .24 attachment + .20 emission delay, nominal cast time is .45.

eventPolicy: Resource deduplication only. Keep each original event, including repeated same-file cues at different times and Ent two-file simultaneous .25-layer. No synthesized replacements, no generic hit/hurt changes.
scope: Static source reachability and source-audio matching only. No Unity/audio audition, original NPC voices completion, camera completion, runtime timer implementation or admission is claimed.
